name: haiku-shunt
description: Marketplace for haiku-shunt, a Claude Code plugin that routes bulk reads to Haiku and tiers file writes between Haiku and Sonnet workers.

plugins.name: haiku-shunt
plugins.description: Deterministically routes bulk file reads and fresh file writes to cheaper subagents via PreToolUse hooks, keeping large/mechanical work out of the main session's context window. Writes are tiered: templated scaffolding goes to a Haiku worker, content that must be derived from reading other code goes to a Sonnet worker. A Claude-only port of Spotify's Shunt/Portal pattern — no external platform or non-Anthropic model required.
